acip: RNAL 'BYOR PA YIN MIN MGO MTSUNGS MDZAD PA YANG, SHES PA RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA YIN NA KENG RUS KYI MAN NGAG SGOM PA LA LTOS PA 'GOG NUS PA'I GNAD KYIS YIN NO,,
english: This is true because of a crucial point here. Even if we were to say that the two observers were the same—in either being a deep practitioner, or not—in a case where their states of mind existed through some nature of their own, we would be able to deny that they were relying on a meditation upon the advices for the practice of the skeletons.
